text: Test scores, X, have mean 54 and variance 144. The scores are scaled using the formula Y = a + bX,
where a and b are constants and b > 0. The scaled scores, Y, have mean 50 and variance 100. Find
the values of a and b. [4]

the width of this confidence interval is 0.157, correct to 3 significant figures, find n. [5]
